occupations.title: Project Management Specialists
occupations.rationale: The excerpts state the product is a work management platform that runs and tracks projects, and specifically mentions 'PPM pros' (project and portfolio management professionals) as a target audience [D:Smartsheet:landing:1, D:Smartsheet:landing:3, D:Smartsheet:landing:5].

occupations.title: Information Technology Project Managers
occupations.rationale: The product is described as a platform that 'connects systems' and integrates AI into workflows, which are tasks commonly overseen by IT project managers [D:Smartsheet:landing:1, D:Smartsheet:landing:4].

occupations.title: General and Operations Managers
occupations.rationale: These managers would use the software to drive 'business efficiencies with process automation' and track 'mission critical projects from inception to implementation' [D:Smartsheet:landing:2, D:Smartsheet:landing:3].
